query:
Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: Purge Cache

on: workflow_dispatch

permissions:
  contents: read # to fetch code (actions/checkout)

jobs:
  build:
    name: Purge GitHub Cache
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest 
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Maven Integration Test Cache
        id: maven-it-cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: maven/target/local-repo
          key: mvn-it-repo
      - name: Check ODC Data Cache
        id: odc-data-cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: core/target/data
          key: odc-data
      - name: Set up JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@b843ebf9b913146b38da2eaa7aeddf76074ae1ad # v6.1.0
        with:
          java-version: '25'
          distribution: 'zulu'
          check-latest: true
          cache: 'maven'
          cache-dependency-path: '**/pom.xml'
      - name: Delete Data Directories
        run: |
          rm -rf ~/.m2/repository/org/owasp/dependency-check-data
          rm -rf maven/target/local-repo/org/owasp/dependency-check-data
          rm -rf core/target/data

results.content:
Cache dependency downloads

Pattern: P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency_cache)

When is cache dependency downloads applicable?

Assess cache dependency downloads for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Repeated dependency fetching is measurable; Cache inputs include lockfile and environment

Contraindications: Mutable or untrusted cached content; An equivalent cache already exists

Method: Choose dependency download state rather than unchecked build outputs; Keep installation and all required tests

Reported finding: Caching has modest aggregate benefit.

Reported metrics: {"vm_time_reduction_percent": {"free": 6, "paid": 3.4}}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.2.1; Table 4; PDF pp. 6, 7: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf

Literature example before:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
download dependencies
install dependencies
run required checks


Literature example after:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
restore dependency downloads by lockfile and environment
install dependencies
run required checks


Literature example diff:

--- knowledge/examples/P-LIT-GHA-CACHE/before.txt
+++ knowledge/examples/P-LIT-GHA-CACHE/after.txt
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 # ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
-download dependencies
+restore dependency downloads by lockfile and environment
 install dependencies
 run required checks
preconditions: Cache inputs include lockfile and environment
